categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Fine is settled promptly by the offender without requiring enforcement steps like notification or added penalties.
categories.rationale: Traced directly to variant V0004 where payment occurs immediately after fine creation without intervening enforcement.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Fine is settled after formal notification and penalty addition have occurred in the enforced branch.
categories.rationale: Traced to variant V0003 where the trace passes through notification and penalty addition before concluding with payment.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Case involves an administrative appeal process directed to the Prefecture following fine enforcement.
categories.rationale: Traced to variant V0006 which includes appeal steps submitted to the Prefecture and a subsequent result ruling.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Case involves an appeal brought before a judicial judge after standard enforcement steps.
categories.rationale: Traced to variant V0005 where the trace ends with an appeal to the judge following notification and penalties.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Unresolved enforced fine is forwarded to a credit collection agent for coercive recovery.
categories.rationale: Traced to variant V0002 which concludes with sending the case for credit collection after all penalties and notifications.
